sn35.232:4.4: Some editions punctuate as if this is a distinct quote, despite the lack of close _-ti_. However, the use of vocatives in the otherwise identical passage at [sn41.1:4.8]() shows that the same speaker continues in the next line.
sn35.232:9.1: It’s unclear to me whether this phrase is looking back to the previous case or forward to the next. It is most commonly used at the end of a section, but sometimes also at the beginning.
